# SkePU-Streaming

\... coming soon. For now, check the recent open-access paper
[@SkePU-Streaming].

*SkePU-Streaming* is a two-layer high-level programming model for
specifying complex stream-processing pipeline workflows for native
execution in distributed heterogeneous parallel systems, with native
stream operators implemented as SkePU programs. It consists of a parser
for annotated (mapped) pipeline workflows, a runtime system, and a
deployment framework, and uses SkePU as a subcomponent. The `skepu::io`
standard library has been extended to provide access to ingoing and
outgoing stream communication ports and for container
serialization/deserialization.

The source code of SkePU-Streaming can be found at
<https://github.com/skepu/skepu-streaming/releases/tag/IJPP-experiments>.
